verdict.rationale: OpenAI has a dedicated streaming-responses guide stating that streaming lets you start printing or processing the beginning of the output while the model keeps generating. That covers the core token-by-token streaming need, and its latency benefit is implied. missing for 10: explicit latency documentation (e.g. time-to-first-token or event timing behavior), details on sub-second full-answer options, independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming latency.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream responses token by token (or get sub-second full answers) with the latency behavior documented

citations.quote: Streaming responses lets you start printing or processing the beginning of the model's output while it continues generating the full response.
